pre_run_condition_only.limitation: This sample preceded the staged run; ambient conditions were not captured beside every fixture prediction, so fixture latency is diagnostic only.

buckets.placement_note: The staged controller was externally terminated while its separately spawned 8192 reload was active. The reload completed and wrote passing parity and determinism reports, but the controller did not launch the final placement inspection.

production_vector_check.limitation: The byte arithmetic confirms dtype and dimension, not a unique model name. The store registration uses an opaque provider identity and carries no model-name provenance.

chunk_reconstruction.summary_fallback_rule: For an empty mapped conversational span, use title plus p1; compartment content was never treated as a transcript.

corpus_identity_gate.decision: No private corpus row was sent through the ladder. Running only the 516 matching chunks, substituting current text for stale vectors, or re-windowing the 545 current windows would violate the same-row requirement.

reembed_duration.reason: The corpus identity gate failed before stable-path compilation and before the first Broca row.

additional_offline_baseline_gap.reason: Pure-cosine baseline retrieval requires query vectors in the production vector space. The supplied query records contain text and metadata but no vectors, and the read-only store has no query-vector table. Calling production or sending private queries to an external provider was outside the isolation boundary.

first_attempt_required_next_inputs: A quiescent read-only store snapshot whose declared memory, commit, and chunk rows match the snapshot contents.
For every chunk baseline vector, canonical text whose SHA-256 equals chunk_hash at the same compartment and window identity, or an explicit frozen transcript export kept in private scratch.

Production-space query vectors for all 298 private queries, generated without touching production and stored beside the private inputs, or an approved exact offline production-embedder checkpoint and preprocessing contract.

sequence_8192.startup_comparison_limitation: The earlier successful load did not sample conditions throughout, so the observations do not define a controlled contention curve.
sequence_8192.fallback: Load the reverified package once, allow Core ML to compile and specialize internally, exclude that one-time load and warmup, and measure all rows warm in that process.

reembed_duration.scope: Warm CPU_AND_NE model-execution wall time for the complete retrievable corpus; database extraction, tokenization, model switching, compilation, specialization, and warmup excluded.
reembed_duration.full_pass_assembly: Each repetition is the sum of four non-overlapping model-resident bucket intervals.

arm_2.purpose: Repeat the quality comparison with instructed production query vectors and no other protocol change.

quality.calibration_gate: known-good relevance >= 0.95, mismatch relevance <= 0.01, and pairwise grade separation >= 0.95

decisive_none_band.conclusion: The recipe question remains unanswered because the judging calibration gate failed.

corrected_calibration_rejudgment.purpose: Re-judge all three retrieval arms with one real-corpus, literal-anchored known-good set keyed by part_id.

instrument.known_good: A real corpus row selected by an exact unique literal from the original keyword-bag query, with deterministic distinctiveness and tie-break ordering and the selection keyed by part_id.
instrument.mismatch: The previously used unrelated natural-history item, unchanged.

all_token_upper_bound_check.description: Treat every parsed query token as a possible literal, including ordinary English words.

instrument.overlap_bias_caveat: A literal-anchored known-good remains among the most lexically overlapping rows in its batch. The gate can show recognition of real answer-shaped evidence, not freedom from overlap bias; only the overlap-band table addresses that bias.

results.decision: The corrected instrument has too few calibratable queries to support its gate. No re-judged candidate or overlap metric is publishable, and neither lever is measurable.

plain_answers.full_reembed_duration: 554.1 seconds (9 minutes 14 seconds) median warm ANE model-execution wall time for 2,204 retrievable rows; observed range 523.6 to 588.5 seconds under one-minute load averages from 2.28 to 29.03.
plain_answers.retrieval_quality_loss: SUPERSEDED by the union-judged run below. The arm-1 figures (ANE precision@10 0.4371 versus production 0.2455) were measured while the production query path sent raw keyword text to an instruction-tuned embedder with no instruction, and while each arm carried its own labels. Under one shared label set and a corrected production recipe, the result reverses: see union_judged_retrieval_quality.
plain_answers.union_judged_retrieval_quality: Production wins once its recipe is correct. Under one shared label set, pure-cosine precision@10 is 0.5262 for production against 0.4258 for the ANE lane, and nDCG@10 is 0.6849 against 0.5925; production leads in every class and every lexical-overlap band. The isolated recipe lever is +22.9 points of none-band relevance for production while the unchanged ANE ranking is flat at 0.0, which is the design's own control. The guidance lever (arm 3 minus arm 2) moves production +2.1 and ANE +2.5 points, below the measured noise floor, so it is unresolved. A row-order permutation control agreed on only 87.1% of binary labels, so the recipe direction is trustworthy and its exact size is not.
plain_answers.what_arm_1_actually_measured: How two embedders degrade on keyword-bag queries sent without an instruction, not their relative quality. It remains a valid measurement of the production system as configured at the time.

union_judged_decisive_run.purpose: Give all three pure-cosine retrieval arms one shared deterministic label set so cross-arm differences reflect retrieval rather than incidental batch neighbours.

query_display_decision.judge_query: original keyword bag for all three arms
query_display_decision.reason: The original bag is the authentic issued request; the rephrasing is a synthetic retrieval treatment and was not promoted to ground truth.
query_display_decision.cost: A keyword bag specifies intent less clearly than a grammatical question and can increase judge noise. The same displayed bag applies to all arms, and the order-sensitivity control measures the residual noise directly.

protocol.judge: local Qwen3.5-35B-A3B Q4_K_M, temperature 0, constrained JSON
protocol.query_display: original keyword bag for every arm
protocol.split_rule: contiguous groups of at most 8 candidate rows after sorting

order_sensitivity.interpretation: Binary relevance changed on 12.90% of candidate labels under order permutation. This is the empirical residual noise floor and materially limits small cross-arm differences.

pool_composition.coverage_note: An arm covers a row when either of its two systems retrieved it. Shares can sum above one because the same union row can be covered by several arms.
pool_composition.per_query_anonymization: Entries are sorted by numeric composition and contain no query or row identity.
pool_composition.per_query_record_encoding: pipe-delimited numeric fields in per_query_record_schema order; shares retain nine decimal places

results.arm_1_published_interval_correction: The published bootstrap intervals resampled queries while treating judge labels as fixed. With only 87.10% binary agreement under row-order permutation in this run, those intervals are too narrow and do not cover judge uncertainty.

interpretation.recipe: Arm 2 minus arm 1 raises production none-band relevance by 22.87 percentage points while unchanged ANE retrieval is exactly flat. The direction survives the observed 12.90% binary order disagreement, but the label noise cautions against treating the exact magnitude as precise.
interpretation.guidance: Arm 3 minus arm 2 raises none-band relevance by 2.09 points for production and 2.50 points for ANE, changing the ANE-minus-production gap by only +0.41 point. These changes are much smaller than the observed order-sensitivity noise floor, so this run does not resolve a guidance effect.

historical_bootstrap_interval_correction.conclusion: The published intervals are too narrow and do not cover judge uncertainty.

interpretation.recipe_conclusion: Production none-band relevance rises 22.87 percentage points while the unchanged ANE ranking is flat. The delta exceeds the raw 12.90% order-induced binary disagreement rate and supports the direction inside this fixed instrument, but the control is not a confidence interval and the effect size remains uncertain.
interpretation.guidance_conclusion: Production and ANE move 2.09 and 2.50 percentage points, and their gap changes by 0.41 point. These movements are below the measured noise floor, so guidance remains unresolved.
